verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no training-data policy, no 'do not train' setting, and no data-retention terms for stagewise's managed inference service. BYOK, local models via Ollama, and optional self-hosting can keep requests away from the stagewise managed service. That is a routing workaround, not a documented opt-out from model training, so it earns no credit. A community user (comm-9) also could not find documentation on what data is sent to the LLM.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
